answer: Proof-of-stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by mandating capital commitment for network influence. Agents must stake tokens to validate transactions, creating a digital grove of secured identity. Like a river eroding stone, the cost of an attack scales linearly with asset concentration. An adversarial raven attempting to spawn infinite fake identities faces prohibitive economic exhaustion, as each node requires an independent, costly capital stake to gain protocol voting rights.
